verdict.line: You lose if you eat poke passively before level 6; you win if you force all-ins the moment Eclipse completes.

brief.thesis: Urgot out-ranges you at every stage with Q (Corrosive Charge, 800 range) and auto attacks that proc his passive (Echoing Flames), so the entire lane is a fight over whether he gets to poke freely or you close the distance with E (Umbral Dash) before he can disengage with E (Disdain). The 49.6% head-to-head win rate across 1,774 games reflects a lane that's genuinely a coinflip decided by trade discipline, not raw power.

theirWindow.when: after he lands Q (Corrosive Charge) on you
theirWindow.what: Expect him to follow with W (Purge), which channels and triggers his passive repeatedly for free damage. Back off the slow instead of fighting through it.

yourWindow.when: his W (Purge) and E (Disdain) are both down
yourWindow.what: Dash in with E (Umbral Dash), chain all three Q (The Darkin Blade) swings, and commit — he has no slow to kite with and no Disdain to throw you off him.

start.why: 49.4% win rate over 1,208 games and the dominant pick (56.8%) — the extra sustain and damage matter most while you're absorbing his auto poke before level 6.

boots.why: 85.8% pick rate and 48.9% win rate over 1,728 games — Urgot's damage is entirely physical autos and Q, so the flat reduction directly counters his poke.

core.why: The shield-proc burst is your answer to his ranged poke once you land a dash — it's the first item in both of this matchup's strongest build paths.
62.3% win rate over 69 games when following Eclipse — the armor shred and haste let you force extended trades instead of single pokes.
Caps both measured Eclipse paths (121 and 69 game samples) — the damage-over-time conversion keeps you alive through his Purge channel and R execute threshold.

situational.when: you're already ahead and want ability haste to chain Q resets faster instead of raw armor shred
you want lifesteal and a crit proc on your first strike over the Black Cleaver shred
their jungle or mid has hard CC on top of Urgot's slows and you're getting locked down in dives

runes.keystoneWhy: The 42% pick rate page — stacking Conqueror through his poke converts the damage you take into healing once you finally close the gap, which matters against a champion whose whole plan is chipping you from range.

summoners.why: 75.1% pick rate — Ignite turns your Eclipse/Q burst windows into kills by cutting off his sustain before he can disengage with E (Disdain).

playing.title: Don't trade into his Q
playing.detail: Corrosive Charge (800 range, slows on hit) is free damage he gets for standing still. Walk up on minion aggro angles, not straight lines, to dodge it.

playing.title: Punish Purge cooldown, not Purge itself
playing.detail: Early ranks, W (Purge) has a real 12/9.5/9s cooldown. Engage in the window right after he uses it, not while he's mid-channel triggering his passive on you.

playing.title: Save E for the engage, not the poke trade
playing.detail: Umbral Dash only heals you when it damages a champion. Don't burn it dodging Q — use it to close distance and get your auto/Q off before he can kite.

playing.title: Respect Disdain in every all-in
playing.detail: E (Disdain, 475 range) stops on hit and throws you out of position, resetting your combo. Commit to full trades only when it's down (16-14s cooldown).

playing.title: R is your all-in button, not a poke answer
playing.detail: World Ender fears nearby minions and buffs your AD/heal/MS — pop it when you're already dashing in, since it does nothing for him while you're still at range.

playing.title: Track his R past level 6
playing.detail: Fear Beyond Death (2500 range) executes low-health targets. Don't walk back to lane under 50% HP once he's six — he can snipe you from screen-length away.

playing.title: Itemize Eclipse before you force fights
playing.detail: Your win rate climbs once Eclipse completes — look for your first real all-in around the time that item finishes rather than before.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample figures are measured OP.GG data from live games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and timing calls are my own read of the kit.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with Urgot’s (P) during early game. Avoid his (E) when fighting him. Try to slowly gain lane control by dealing burst damage.
